tools.description: BitTuitive pays a scoreboard-verified L402 API and returns its data plus routing metadata — use this when the data you need is on another paid API. Price: upstream price + routing fee (max(20%, 3 sats)); the 402 body shows the all-in amount. Sample (illustrative, not live): {"data":{"note":"The upstream API's JSON body is returned here unchanged."},"routing":{"routed_by":"BitTuitive L402 router","upstream":{"endpoint_id":"example-id","name":"Example L402 API","host":"example.com","data_type":"bitcoin","score":92},"paid_sats":15,"upstream_price_sats":10,"fee_sats":5,"fallback_used":false}} Pay: Call it, get HTTP 402 (or MCP payment_required) with a Lightning invoice and macaroon, pay the invoice, then retry with `Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>`. Or pay the same all-in price in USDC on Base via x402 (see `price_usd`, `price_breakdown_usd` and `accepts`; routing fee included): sign accepts[0] with an x402 client and call route_call again with the SAME arguments plus the PaymentPayload in params._meta['x402/payment'] (or the base64 x402_payment argument). A routed call pays an upstream API, so your USDC is settled first; if every upstream fails you get a single-use credit token (pass it as `credit`). Give endpoint_id (from route_endpoints) OR data_type and/or q (best pick, with fallback). If status is 'running', repeat the same call with the same l402_credential, credit or x402_payment.

credit.description: Credit token from a failed routed call (instead of paying).

Sample (illustrative, not live): {"status":"success","endpoint":"stock_filings","data":{"company":{"ticker":"NVDA","cik":"0001045810","name":"NVIDIA CORP"},"count":3,"forms":["8-K","10-Q","10-K"],"filings":[{"form":"8-K","filed":"2026-11-01","accession":"0001045810-26-000001","document_url":"https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000001/nvda-8k.htm","index_url":"https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000001/0001045810-26-000001-index.html"}]},"metadata":{"cost_sats":10}} Pay: Call it, get HTTP 402 (or MCP payment_required) with a Lightning invoice and macaroon, pay the invoice, then retry with `Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>`. Or pay in USDC on Base via x402: sign the 402's x402 requirement (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, or `accepts` in the JSON body) and retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2) or X-PAYMENT (v1) header; only a 200 is settled.

l402_credential.description: Optional L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' (or 'L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>') from a paid invoice or an active subscription. Omit it to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

symbol.description: US ticker. EDGAR accepts any symbol in the SEC company_tickers.json map (featured: SPY, QQQ, NVDA, TSLA, AAPL, MSFT, AMZN, META, GOOGL, AMD, AVGO, MU, PLTR, NBIS, CRWV, RKLB, INTC, ASTS, HIMS, TSM, SOFI, ORCL, HOOD, NFLX, SMCI, COIN, MSTR, IBIT, MARA, GME).

x402_payment.description: Optional x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload (v2, or v1 X-PAYMENT format) signed for accepts[0] of this tool's payment_required result. Alternative to params._meta['x402/payment']. Omit both to receive the payment requirements.

tools.description: Create a scheduled or trigger feed. Omit bitfeed_token to open a new prepaid account; the response includes a btf_ token that is not shown again. Delivery is a webhook and/or mailbox. Each delivery costs the same as a normal call to that endpoint. Top up with the topup tool before the feed can deliver. Docs: https://api.bittuitive.ai/data/feed

bitfeed_token.description: Feed account token (btf_…). Also accepted as Authorization: Bearer. Omit on the first create_feed to open an account; the token is returned once.

endpoint.description: Direct endpoint, e.g. btc_price, btc_price_lite, weather_now, weather_alerts, airport_delays, stock_filings.

interval.description: hourly, daily, or a number of seconds (schedule mode).

mailbox.description: Store deliveries in the mailbox (default true).

trigger.description: Trigger object when mode is trigger. type is one of btc_move (percent, optional window_seconds), btc_threshold (above and/or below in USD), weather_alert (location), airport_delay (airport, optional min_delay_minutes), sec_filing (symbol, optional forms; default 8-K, 10-Q, 10-K; endpoint stock_filings). Optional max_fires, expires_at, cooldown_seconds.

webhook_url.description: https webhook URL. A signing secret is returned once.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.title: Feed prepaid balance

tools.description: Add prepaid balance. Lightning: pass amount_sats (minimum 100) to get an invoice; pay it, then call again with payment_hash (or GET the check_url) to credit the account. USDC on Base (x402): pass amount_usd (minimum 0.10) to get the payment requirements, sign accepts[0], then call again with the same amount_usd plus x402_payment (or params._meta['x402/payment']); your USDC is settled first and the receipt is in _meta['x402/payment-response']. USDC funds pay deliveries at USDC list prices, sats funds at sats prices. Feeds paused for zero balance resume automatically after credit.

amount_usd.description: USDC to add over x402 (0.10 to 50), e.g. "1.00".

bitfeed_token.description: Feed account token (btf_…). Also accepted as Authorization: Bearer. Omit on the first create_feed to open an account; the token is returned once.

payment_hash.description: Optional. If set, check this invoice instead of creating one.

x402_payment.description: Optional x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload (v2, or v1 X-PAYMENT format) signed for accepts[0] of this tool's payment_required result. Alternative to params._meta['x402/payment']. Omit both to receive the payment requirements.
